Table 1 'CCS Costs' block: US$ 2008. Inside it, the coal power investment row is labelled US$2006/kW (Fig. 3, IEA 2008a). Text costs state no year (and one is in EUR). The main file uses only the Table 1 US$2008 abatement and transport/storage costs; text-only costs without a year are in the main file only for transport and storage (2010_USD flagged), otherwise in sidecars.

The brief has no technology table; it is used for sector abatement costs, emission reductions and a few energy flows. Main file: natural gas processing, iron and steel, cement and ammonia - Table 1 abatement-cost ($/tCO2 AVOIDED, US$2008) and Table 1 'CO2 abatement' % as capture-rate (modeller's decision); cement also capture-rate 95% of the limestone off-gas and heat/electricity flows per t clinker (p.4); refineries: 6.2 GJ natural gas per t CO2 captured (p.4); cryogenic air separation: capacity and about 0.8 GJ electricity per t O2 (p.3). CO2 TRANSPORT AND STORAGE (added 2026-09-25, archetypes pipeline_co2 and well_co2-storage; nodes sector 'transmission', end-use 'co2-transport-and-storage', unit t): one example per technology per table or passage, cases in square brackets - Table 1 pipeline cost-levelized [2 MtCO2/yr] and [5-10 MtCO2/yr] and saline storage [onshore] and [offshore] (US$2008); p.5 transport-and-compression electricity flow 0.2-0.5 GJ/t per 100-200 km; p.9 pipeline capex per km [0.7 m onshore] and [offshore]; p.9 storage cost-levelized (seven cases: IPCC, IEA GHG, average, In-Salah); p.5 EOR storage $20-30/t. Text costs have no currency year: 2010_USD flagged. Sidecars (not loaded): _transport-and-storage (shipping - transport but not pipeline; Table 1 EOR whole-chain cost; ECBM methane; depleted-gas cost-supply point; power-analysis T&S assumption), _industrial-text-costs (text-only costs with no year or no avoided/captured basis: blast furnace, DRI, black liquor, refinery >$200, In-Salah, Sleipner; Table 1 synfuels column, which has no single host archetype), _power-sector (utility power: avoided and captured costs, investment costs in US$2006, O&M, electricity-cost impact, efficiency penalty, MEA energy, 2030 projections - out of scope), _baseline-emissions (Table 1 emissions of host plants without capture). Omitted: storage-capacity estimates, project descriptions beyond cost figures, policy, Fig. 2 and Fig. 3 (charts, not digitised). LEVELIZED COSTS (2026-09-25): five text costs moved from _industrial-text-costs to the main file as cost-levelized (2010_USD flagged) - blast furnace capture $25-35/t and CCS incl. transport and storage $40-50/t, cement $50-75/t clinker, UK refineries >$200/t, In-Salah $6/t injected - and the pipeline_co2 and well_co2-storage cost-levelized rows now carry COST BASIS: total-plant (they are the whole transport or storage service); HiSmelt/DRI, black liquor (no example), Sleipner (operation cost only) and synfuels stay in the sidecar.

(1) Mixed currency years in Table 1: the cost block is US$2008 but the investment row is US$2006/kW. (2) Coal and gas power $/tCO2 avoided: 60-75 and 60-110 in Table 1 vs $35-55 and $53-73 on p.8. (3) Ship transport: $15-30/tCO2 per 1000 km (Table 1) vs $15-20 (p.9). (4) Iron and steel: 'CO2 abatement' 50-75% (Table 1) vs 'abatement potential between 85% and 95%' (p.3) - the latter is the blast furnace alone. (5) Table 1 iron and steel '(25) 65-75' and synfuels '60-100(150)' carry unexplained parenthetical values; 65-75 and ammonia 30-35 do not appear in the body. (6) The emissions row mixes units: 'nat. gas up to 70%' is a CO2 concentration in a row of tCO2/t. (7) p.8 prints '$30/kWh for gas plants' for $30/MWh. (8) 'Physical adsorption' is used for physical-solvent absorption (pre-combustion, blast furnace), inviting a wrong mapping to adsorbers. (9) Table 1 cement '~65%' is plant-wide, while the text's 95% is for the limestone off-gas only. (10) 'O&M costs 4% (6%)' - the (6%) is unexplained. (11) ASU energy: 0.28-0.30 kWh/Nm3 is 0.71-0.76 GJ/t, printed as 'about 0.8 GJ/tO2'. (12) Chemical absorption energy '0.3 kWh/kg CO2' does not say whether it is heat or electricity. (13) Storage cost estimates in the text span $1-25/t across sources; Table 1 gives one saline range per location.
